title: Politics and Public Policy, Minor (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: 18-19cr bulletin nominal, computed 22cr. Distinct from the already-built PLSCMIN (the plain Political Science minor). Prescribed PLSC 1 (3cr) + PLSC 202 (3cr, the bulletin's 'PLSC 202 or PUBPL 304' pick -- PLSC 202 chosen since no pubpl_catalog.json exists in this project's scraped data). Methods requirement (the bulletin's 'PLSC 309/309H or STAT 200' pick, 3-4cr) filled with STAT 200 (4cr). Real hidden-prereq gap: STAT 200 needs MATH 21, not otherwise part of this minor -- added explicitly (MATH 21 is prereq-free per math_catalog.json, the same hidden-prereq pattern already used for STAT 200/SCM 200/ACCTG 211 across several earlier minor batches this session). Supporting Courses pool (9cr, bulletin requires min. 6cr at 400-level) filled entirely within PLSC to keep the chain simple: PLSC 404 (Analyzing Public Policy in the American States) + PLSC 460 (Science, Technology, and Public Policy) + PLSC 490 (Policy Making and Evaluation), all prereq-free, all directly policy-themed and all at the 400-level (exceeding the 6cr minimum). Computed total: PLSC 1 (3) + PLSC 202 (3) + MATH 21 (3, hidden) + STAT 200 (4) + PLSC 404/460/490 (9) = 22cr against the bulletin's 18-19cr nominal, same documented-not-absorbed overshoot convention as SCISTMIN's own hidden-prereq chain in an earlier batch.
